header.name: PatrixWorld-Tectonic BP [SCHEMA-FIX v0.3.0]
header.description: v0.3.0 SCHEMA-FIX — corrects all schema errors found in v0.2.0 test. (1) biome format_version back to '1.21.110' (Microsoft canonical example; v0.2 swap to '1.13.0' failed with 'no parser available'). (2) client_biome format_version is '1.21.40' per Microsoft docs. (3) client_biome foliage_appearance uses 'color' field, not 'foliage_color' (schema rejected the latter). Same fix on grass_appearance. (4) Removed fog_appearance component entirely (referenced non-existent 'minecraft:default' fog asset). IMPORTANT: world must have 'Custom Biomes' experimental toggle ENABLED for minecraft:replace_biomes to take effect. Without that toggle, biomes parse cleanly but don't replace anything.
